text:
Aisha (PM): Quick sync — we need a concise bottleneck matrix for the upcoming Aurora private-onramp. Customer requires 99.5% P99 <= 250ms token latency for text gen in staged rollout. Who owns which risk/mitigation?

Diego (Eng): I can start the matrix for infra/runtime items. Need input from Maya on KV cache behaviour and from Sam on capacity lanes.

Maya (Runtime): I ran a quick perf pass on the quantized variant; latency looks fine at low conc, but tail spikes with cold KV cache and long prefixes. Suggest we note: prefix hit rate sensitivity, cache warming window, async prefetch.

Sam (Infra): For Dedicated pools we can reserve burst slots for canary windows, but that needs a capacity commit. Two options: (1) reserve + prewarm GPU pool; (2) rely on burst autoscale — latter risks cold starts.

Lena (Security): Need to flag HSM/KMS key provisioning timeline for Private: cert rotations and role approvals take ~3 business days. If we gate on HSM for private beta, that moves the launch by 1 sprint.

Aisha (PM): Good. Product constraints: customers want V1 by mid-next-quarter; PMs OK with a staggered rollout (10% -> 50% -> 100%) if we can hit P50/P90 targets and have rollback policy. We need Launch Criteria section in the matrix.

Raj (ProdOps): I'll map the rollout gates to runbook checks. We should include the canary metrics: token latency P90/P99, error rate, model divergence (small sample eval) and billing anomalies.

Diego (Eng): For sequencing propose: 1) Security infra (KMS/HSM approval) 2) Prewarm automation + runtime KV cache prefetch 3) Canary config and autoscaler policy 4) Customer pilot. Each step with owner + eta.

Maya (Runtime): Adding technical notes for the matrix:
- Cache prewarm TTL: 30m recommended for customer flows with heavy reuse
- Batch size cap: 8 for low-latency mode on A100-p4 (tune later)
- Fallback model: quantized-8bit variant with reduced context for overloaded nodes

Sam (Infra): Ops constraints: to do the reserve + prewarm we need a PO for reserved capacity by EOD Thu. Otherwise we'll schedule prewarm jobs that may be bumped by other commitments.

Lena (Security): Also add compliance check: audit logging must be enabled and log retention set to 90 days for the pilot. That needs a console flag turned on and storage allocation.

Aisha (PM): Concrete ask: Diego & Maya to deliver the bottleneck matrix (table rows: area, risk, impact, mitigation, owner, eta) by Tue EOD. Sam & Lena to add infra/security gating items and delivery dates. Raj to attach runbook gating metrics.

Diego (Eng): Ack — I'll post a first draft matrix in this thread by Tue morning.

Maya (Runtime): I'll include a short experiment plan for cache prewarm + a small perf caveat: long-context customers might need KV-sharding to avoid single-node tail.

Sam (Infra): I'll check capacity pricing options and give two commit options (reserved vs burst) by Tue EOD.

Lena (Security): I'll confirm HSM timeline and audit-log config by Monday. If HSM required, note +3bd shift.

Raj (ProdOps): I'll start the canary metric spec and test harness checklist, will attach sample queries to validate model drift.

Aisha (PM): Good. One more thing — customer asked about encryption-in-transit certs for Private: please add that to security gating.

Lena (Security): Added. Also flag: SCIM provisioning for customer seats may need workspace config; that's separate but callout in matrix.

Diego (Eng): One engineering tradeoff to call out in the matrix: tightening P99 requires more reserved capacity and aggressive prewarm, which increases $/token. We should include cost delta estimates.

Maya (Runtime): For cost notes: quantized-8bit saves ~35% compute; batching + caching can save another ~20% but may increase latency tail for bursty traffic. I'll put numbers in the matrix.

Aisha (PM): Perfect. If anyone has blockers to the Tue/Monday dates call them out now. Otherwise we'll treat this as the working plan.

Sam (Infra): No blockers from infra execs, but we need PO approvals from finance to reserve capacity.

Diego (Eng): Small blocker: I'd like one extra SRE day to wire up tracing for KV misses — will request via eng-ops.

Aisha (PM): Go ahead, Diego. Add SRE day to matrix as dependency.

deploy-bot: Scheduled reminder set for Tue 09:00 to post "bottleneck matrix draft" in #product.

Aisha (PM): Thanks all. Final deliverables list (add to matrix):
- Bottleneck matrix doc (Diego + Maya) — Tue EOD
- Infra commit options (Sam) — Tue EOD
- Security gating + timelines (Lena) — Mon EOD
- Canary metric spec + runbook (Raj) — Tue EOD
- Cost delta estimates (Maya + Diego) — Tue EOD

Diego (Eng): I'll link the matrix here when ready. :eyes:

Maya (Runtime): I'll include a short perf-run artifact and raw p95/p99 logs.

Lena (Security): If anyone needs a meeting with security to speed approvals, ping me and I'll book.

Aisha (PM): Okay locking this as the plan. We'll reconvene after matrix drop. :rocket:
